Messages.Author: Santh
Messages.Body:
Command the Legion
Blood Cost X
[dom] Tap X-1 allies or younger vampires.
[DOM] As above, but one of the minions may be the same age or older.

can i take the action for X blood when there are less then X-1 legal minion targets on the table?

i think not, but i want to be sure.

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> Santh wrote:
> Command the Legion
> Blood Cost X
> [dom] Tap X-1 allies or younger vampires.
> [DOM] As above, but one of the minions may be the same age or older.
>
> can i take the action for X blood when there are less then X-1 legal minion targets on the table?
>
> i think not, but i want to be sure.
>
No you can't. In order to tap X-1 guys, there must be X-1 valid targets when announcing the action (there can be less though when resolving it).
